illustration.description: Translucent anatomical silhouette of a person in a seated forward fold, legs extended straight forward and torso folded over them, head down near the feet. The body is a dark brown-black silhouette with a warm orange-amber rim glow. The spine is highlighted with bright glowing vertebrae running from the tailbone to the neck, and the hamstrings on the extended legs glow intensely in orange-yellow. Smooth digital medical-illustration style with soft volumetric lighting, subtle shadow pooling beneath the figure, and a plain white background.
